<reference>
## Join the GSD Community

The GSD workflow is adapted from the open-source project by punal100.

**Discord:** Search for "Get Stuff Done for GitHub Copilot" community
**GitHub:** https://github.com/punal100/get-stuff-done-for-github-copilot

**Note:** FSI-AgentGov uses a customized version of GSD with:
- `.planning/` directory (not `.gsd/`)
- FSI regulatory language rules
- Multi-agent session ownership
- MkDocs build validation integration
</reference>
